summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for SajiloHealth enterprise redesign (iteration 2). All 14 review checkpoints pass. New sections (InvestorStrip marquee, Roadmap stepper) render correctly. Hero dashboard mockup visible with KPI cards, chart, queue, and floating Payment/Prescription cards. 5-item nav anchor-scrolls to all sections. EN/NE language toggle changes copy across hero/investor strip/pillars/roadmap, persists via localStorage 'sh_lang' across reload. Trust section has 4 stats + 4 detail points. Roadmap step-0 has active emerald styling. Beta form validates (email + role), success state + Sonner toast on valid submit, lead stored in 'sh_leads'. Footer has 3 columns (Platform/Company/Legal) + 'Private Beta · Active' pill. No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 375x800.

issues: Privacy and Terms links both anchor to #trust (placeholder). Carried over from iteration 1; replace with real routes before public launch.

critical_code_review_comments: Footer Privacy/Terms still placeholder to #trust — replace with real routes before public launch.
Roadmap progress bar width is hardcoded to '12.5%' inline style — fine for static demo, but if roadmap steps become dynamic, derive it from active step index.
BetaForm uses setTimeout(600ms) to mock submit — acceptable since FE-only; wire to real backend when available.
i18n copy.js is now ~440 lines; consider splitting per-section (hero.js, roadmap.js, etc.) if it keeps growing.
Inline opacity SVG patterns and large component files (Hero.jsx ~290 lines) are still readable; no action needed.
seed_data_creation: Test wrote lead to localStorage key 'sh_leads' (email=test@sajilo.np, role=doctor). FE-only, no backend persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 checkpoints verified via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://nepal-health-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: 5 nav links (patients/doctors/clinics/trust/roadmap) anchor-scroll, hero CTAs (#beta and #clinics), hero eyebrow text 'HEALTHCARE INFRASTRUCTURE FOR NEPAL', investor-strip marquee contains Healthcare Infrastructure/Encrypted by Design/NepalPay/Limited Beta labels, 4 what-pillar cards, 4 trust-stat + 4 trust-point cards, 4 roadmap-step nodes with step-0 marked 'Active', EN/NE toggle (NE shows 'नेपाल' in hero headline, persists across reload, EN restores 'operating system'), beta form empty/invalid/valid flows, success state + lead in localStorage, footer 3 columns (Platform/Company/Legal — note CSS uppercase transform on column headings) and 'Private Beta · Active' status pill, mobile 375x800 has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=375), zero console errors and zero page errors.
rca of the issue: No bugs detected. Initial test run showed a 'footer missing Platform' false negative — root cause: footer column headings use CSS uppercase transform so inner_text() returns 'PLATFORM'. Re-verified using :text-is() selectors which correctly found Platform/Company/Legal in DOM. No real bug.
